objective: Compute a joint active/reactive dispatch for an islanded microgrid with a diesel unit and grid-forming inverter.

title.en: REL-TASK-022 — Joint active/reactive dispatch in an islanded microgrid
title.ru: REL-TASK-022 — Совместная диспетчеризация P/Q в изолированной микросети

objective.en: Balance active and reactive demand while respecting inverter apparent-power capability and maintaining voltage limits.
objective.ru: Сбалансировать активную и реактивную нагрузку с учётом полной мощности инвертора и допустимых напряжений.

instructions.en: Use islanded_pq_case. Dispatch diesel and inverter P/Q so that active and reactive demand are balanced. Use the inverter active availability first, keep inverter P/Q within its apparent-power circle, compute voltage from the supplied linear model, and report dispatch, voltage_pu, and total_cost.
instructions.ru: Используйте islanded_pq_case. Задайте P/Q дизеля и инвертора так, чтобы балансировать активную и реактивную нагрузку. Сначала используйте доступную активную мощность инвертора, соблюдайте круг полной мощности инвертора, вычислите напряжение по заданной линейной модели и укажите dispatch, voltage_pu и total_cost.

submission_schema.dispatch: object with diesel and inverter P/Q values
submission_schema.total_cost: diesel active cost plus reactive deviation penalty

hard_constraints: Active and reactive balances must be satisfied.
Inverter P/Q must respect apparent-power capability; diesel P/Q must respect limits.
Voltage and total cost must match the independent calculation within tolerance.
Unknown extra answer keys are infeasible.

metrics.name: feasible
metrics.description: Whether the submitted P/Q dispatch satisfies all hard constraints.
